method: Exact triangle/constant-Z intersections, aperture left/right midpoint, median over |Z|=2..10 mm in 0.25 mm steps and Y limits 5/6/7 mm. Independently remove each shell scan symmetry-centre offset. No scaling or rotation.
limitations: Shell cut-outs, not installed socket/contact axes; sample spread is method sensitivity, not calibrated scan accuracy. Physical fit remains unverified.
